mapping_alignment.note: Section headings checked against 01 Playbook; numbered artefacts checked against the packaged 00–50 filenames and 02 Index. These are candidate review touchpoints, not required changes, legal applicability findings, or approval. The post-adoption suite-amendment approver is unconfirmed. Old scanner records retain their historical labels; no legacy identifier is silently reassigned.

note: Deterministic case-insensitive topic matches identify proposed-suite sections and artefacts to review, not legal obligations or decisions. An item may match several topics. Unresolved scope questions are flagged per topic.

proposed_relationship_pointer.name: Capabilities and System Map
proposed_relationship_pointer.status: unnumbered standalone proposal; not an adopted catalogue entry
proposed_relationship_pointer.purpose: Optional pointer for relating outcome-led use cases, capabilities, governed systems and referenced components; reconcile official system identity to 05 and component authority to native sources.

relevance_gate.note: An item must match at least one of these before it is recorded at all. Applied to sources whose filter is set to 'keywords'.

focus_gate.note: High-signal AI-governance gate. A general item needs both an AI signal and a governance, legal, assurance or public-sector signal. A change to a watched statute is tested against the amending instrument, not the name of the affected Act. This prevents every ordinary amendment to the Equality Act, Housing Act or another watched statute entering the feed. Direct priority frameworks are always retained. Rejections remain in discards.json.
priority_phrases: digital information and smart data bill

topics.label: Automated decision-making and Articles 22A to 22D
affects_artefacts: WCC-AIG-41 AI Contestability and Redress Control
topics.why: Review ADM safeguards, privacy assessment and human review/contestability routes when source material changes; determine applicability for the specific case.

topics.label: Algorithmic transparency reporting
topics.why: Check transparency drafting, register and reporting touchpoints; the current local-authority ATRS position must be checked by the responsible owner.

topics.label: Agentic AI and autonomous action
affects_artefacts: WCC-AIG-44 Agentic AI Governance Design Principles
topics.why: The proposed agentic annex and agent records define the review route. A source match does not establish that a live agent or control exists.

topics.label: Equality, bias and discrimination
topics.why: Review fairness risk and equality assessment design; legal duties and case-specific effects need specialist review.

topics.label: AI security and cyber threat
affects_artefacts: WCC-AIG-13 Supplier AI Due Diligence Questionnaire
topics.why: Threat guidance changes faster than anything else in the set and the checklist is the artefact that goes stale first.

topics.label: Procurement and third-party assurance
affects_artefacts: WCC-AIG-13 Supplier AI Due Diligence Questionnaire
topics.why: Most council AI is bought rather than built, so procurement rules bite before any internal gate does.

topics.label: Management system and assurance standards
affects_artefacts: WCC-AIG-27 AIMS Applicable Requirements and Change Register
topics.why: Review proposed standards alignment and requirements tracking; a source update does not establish conformity.

topics.label: Shadow AI and acceptable use
affects_artefacts: WCC-AIG-03 Staff Guide Do I Need To Register AI
topics.why: Review staff routing and acceptable-use guidance for uncontrolled adoption.

topics.label: EU AI Act
topics.why: Reference context only: topic matches deliberately emit no change flags. Whether the EU AI Act applies to any case is for the responsible legal owner.
topics.review_flag: Conditional EU territorial and activity scope; do not infer applicability from a publisher match.

topics.label: Local government specific
affects_artefacts: WCC-AIG-21 AI Governance Terms of Reference
topics.why: Review intake, register and governance routing against sector-specific source changes; determine binding effect separately.

topics.label: Maladministration and Ombudsman findings
affects_artefacts: WCC-AIG-41 AI Contestability and Redress Control
topics.why: Review complaints, incident learning and redress routes when relevant findings appear; do not treat another authority's finding as a decision for this Council.

topics.label: Safeguarding, children's services and adult social care
topics.why: Review resident-impact scoring and specialist assessments for safeguarding uses; the service owner and legal specialists determine which duties apply.

topics.label: Procurement Act 2023 regime
affects_artefacts: WCC-AIG-13 Supplier AI Due Diligence Questionnaire
topics.why: Review supplier checks and the delegated-decision boundary; a scanner match does not establish which procurement regime applies.
topics.review_flag: Legacy and current procurement regimes may differ by contract; confirm transitional rules and delegated authority.

topics.label: Freedom of information and disclosure exposure
topics.why: Review transparency and record-design touchpoints; disclosure and exemptions need case-specific information-rights review.
topics.review_flag: Do not assume every register field or model card is disclosable; exemptions and publication duties require owner review.

scope: England, single-tier authority. Topics are the frameworks a council is actually judged against, not UK AI policy in general.
